detailZones.title: Inspection tool bench
detailZones.description: Inspect the visible pegboard, adjustable lamp, parts tray, tool cup and drawer bench.

detailZones.title: Baggage X-ray conveyor
detailZones.translation: 行李 X 光传送带
detailZones.description: Trace the scanner housing, curtain-lined tunnel, conveyor rollers and adjacent operator display.

detailZones.title: Open baggage and examination table
detailZones.description: Explore the open carry-on case and distinct surfaces, supports and storage beneath its examination table.

detailZones.title: Closed baggage and tray table
detailZones.description: Inspect the navy wheeled case, empty gray tray, second steel table and its visible frame.

detailZones.title: Inspection staff workstation
detailZones.description: Identify the blank monitor, telephone, keyboard, desk, drawer pedestal and office chair.

detailZones.title: Tray storage and room fittings
detailZones.description: Explore the tray rack, storage bins, glazed partition, door hardware, ceiling fittings and nearby floor.

anchorAudit.rationale: The final 1600 by 900 JPEG was reviewed at native size. The 150 anchors identify visible scanner, bench, luggage, tray, workstation and room-fixture objects or parts within 6 focus zones. Hidden contents, personal identity, document contents, inspection outcomes, legal status, security threats, brands and inferred actions were excluded.
